newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah eases on liquidity, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah eases on liquidity, trade slow.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah eased against the dollar in early trading on Monday on the back of generally ample liquidity, dealers said.
One foreign bank dealer said trading was slow due to a lack of fresh market factors.
"The local currency is likely to remain moving in a tight range the rest of the day due to a lack of fresh market factors," another bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,431.30/31.80 at 0320 GMT against an opening of 2,430.50/31.50.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,431.00/31.70 and 2,431.00/31.50, respectively.
Dealers said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,431.00 to 2,432.00 the rest of the day.
Overnight swap was at 0.20/0.25 while tom/next was at 0.12/0.16 points.
One-month swaps were at 13.50/14.25, two at 26.50/27.50, three at 41.50/42.50 and six at 84.25/85.00 points.
The central bank, Bank Indonesia, kept its intervention band at 2,425/2,617 and its conversion band at 2,425/2,473 on Friday.
